ns2:course.label: Studies in Francophonie
ns2:course.description: Studies of various genres, periods, and topics of French literature outside of France, with a different geographical emphasis each term. Regions include black Africa, the Caribbean, Canada, North Africa, the Middle East, and Switzerland. Same as CWL 434. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Maximum of 12 undergraduate hours or 16 graduate hours.
